summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new auth/freemium/Stripe expansion. 14/14 pytest backend tests pass (auth register/login/me/logout, duplicate email 400, wrong password 401, admin pro_annual, freemium 3-wall limit + 402, admin unlimited, /api/limits for free/pro, user isolation A vs B, GET/DELETE other user's wall = 404, Stripe /plans public with R$ 39,90 & R$ 399,00, /checkout creates payment_transactions with status=initiated, /status public, checkout requires auth). Frontend: unauth / redirects to /login; login-card has all testids (login-card, btn-google-login, login-form, input-email, input-password, btn-submit-login, link-cadastro); admin login lands at / with user-bar='Administrador PRO'; btn-logout clears session and redirects to /login; /cadastro has all testids (register-card, btn-google-register, input-name/email/password, btn-submit-register, link-login); new-user registration lands at / with 'GRÁTIS' tag + 'Assinar PRO' button; /precos renders pricing-grid with plan-free (SEU PLANO tag), plan-pro_monthly + btn-subscribe-pro_monthly, plan-pro_annual + btn-subscribe-pro_annual, and shows R$ 39,90 and R$ 399,00; freemium block on /parede/nova: after 3 walls, clicking btn-salvar-tudo shows sonner toast 'Limite gratuito de 3 paredes atingido. Assine o plano PRO para paredes ilimitadas.' with Assinar PRO action button (screenshot captured).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py get_current_user_optional silently swallows all JWT decode errors returning None — acceptable but log at DEBUG for observability.
payments.py uses `stripe.Price.list(lookup_keys=[lk])` on every /plans call — consider caching for a few minutes to reduce Stripe API calls (currently ~2 API calls per pricing page load).

server.py CORS uses `allow_origins=['*']` when FRONTEND_URL is missing but also `allow_credentials=True` — the browser will reject cookies with wildcard origins; currently OK because Kubernetes ingress rewrites and FRONTEND_URL is likely set, but explicit list is safer.
auth.py seed_admin re-hashes password on every startup if password changed — idempotent and correct.

server.py legacy walls with user_id=null are only visible via the /export endpoint fallback (no user); GET /api/walls scopes strictly to user_id — orphan walls are effectively hidden from all users. Consider a one-time migration to attach them to the admin user, or a admin-only /api/walls/legacy list.
test_credentials: admin@tudomaisfacil.com / admin123 (pro_annual). New free users created dynamically via /api/auth/register with test_*@example.com.
seed_data_creation: Created several test users (test_*@example.com) and their walls for freemium/isolation tests, plus 4 admin walls for admin-no-limit test, and 1 initiated Stripe payment_transactions row (no card submitted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth + freemium + Stripe all working end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0`. Note tests use `-n 0` because pytest-xdist is default-on via pytest.ini; parallel run was flaky for session/wall isolation. Sonner toast for freemium 402 uses text pattern 'Limite gratuito de 3 paredes atingido. Assine o plano PRO para paredes ilimitadas.' with an 'Assinar PRO' action link.
